justifications.fit: _run_diff_store at reckon/crew/reports.py:1422 is a small docstringed helper sitting beside _citation_stores and _plan_label_findings, matching their idiom, with no plan or version token in its name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/reports.py:1472 passes the worktree-preferring store into _added_lines_since, so the added-plan-label refusal now fires on the run's own unmerged change.
